# Hostile argument vectors for tools/auditor-tools' audit-scan. test-auditor-tools.sh runs each one in a working
# directory that is a git repository holding:
#   a.rs and src/lib.rs (files), src/linked.rs (a link to a file outside), linkdir (a link to the directory outside),
#   fifo (a FIFO);
#   audit_1 and incident_1 (run directories), audit_2 (no .gitignore), audit_3 (a link to audit_1), audit_4 (its
#   .gitignore tracked), audit_5 (holding a link), audit_6 (prescan.json a link to a file outside), audit_7
#   (prescan.json a second name of a file outside), audit_8 (prescan.json a directory).
# The directory outside holds a canary no case may print.
# One case per line: <exit status><TAB><the one stderr line><TAB><argument>[<TAB><argument>...]. Each case prints
# nothing on stdout and changes nothing in the working directory or outside it. In a field:
#   @WT@ the working directory's absolute path   @OUT@ the directory outside it   @LONG:N@ N repetitions of "a"
#   @NL@ a newline   @ESC@ an escape character (0x1b)   @TAB@ a tab   @EMPTY@ (a whole field) an empty argument
#   @SHOWN(x)@ x as the binary shows a value in a message: cut after 200 bytes, then ...
# grammar
2	audit-scan: refused: no directory to scan (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])
2	audit-scan: refused: it takes one directory (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	src
2	audit-scan: refused: unknown option --help (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	--help
2	audit-scan: refused: unknown option -h (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	-h
2	audit-scan: refused: unknown option --version (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	--version
2	audit-scan: refused: unknown option -- (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	--	.
2	audit-scan: refused: unknown option - (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	-
2	audit-scan: refused: unknown option --pretty=yes (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	--pretty=yes
2	audit-scan: refused: unknown option --outfile (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	--outfile	audit_1/prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: unknown option --ou (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	--ou	audit_1/prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: unknown option -o (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	-o	audit_1/prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --pretty is given more than once (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	--pretty	--pretty
2	audit-scan: refused: --out is given more than once (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	--out	audit_1/prescan.json	--out=audit_1/prescan-2.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out needs a file (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	.	--out
2	audit-scan: refused: --out is empty	.	--out=
2	audit-scan: refused: --out may not start with - or ~: --pretty	.	--out	--pretty
2	audit-scan: refused: --out may not start with - or ~: --out	.	--out	--out
2	audit-scan: refused: it takes one directory (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	src	audit_1
2	audit-scan: refused: --out is given more than once (usage: audit-scan <dir> [--out <run dir>/prescan.json | <run dir>/prescan-<slug>.json] [--pretty])	--out=audit_1/prescan.json	.	--out	audit_1/prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out may not start with - or ~: --pretty	--out=--pretty	.
# the directory to scan
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan must be relative to the working directory: @SHOWN(@WT@)@	@WT@
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan must be relative to the working directory: @SHOWN(@WT@/src)@	@WT@/src
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan must be relative to the working directory: @SHOWN(@OUT@)@	@OUT@
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan must be relative to the working directory: /	/
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: ..	..
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: ../outside	../outside
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: ./..	./..
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: src/..	src/..
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: src/../..	src/../..
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: src/./x	src/./x
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: src//x	src//x
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: src/	src/
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: ./	./
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has an empty, . or .. component: ././src	././src
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan may not start with - or ~: ~	~
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan may not start with - or ~: ~/src	~/src
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan is empty	@EMPTY@
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan passes through a symbolic link: linkdir	linkdir
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan passes through a symbolic link: linkdir/x	linkdir/x
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan passes through a symbolic link: src/linked.rs	src/linked.rs
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan passes through a symbolic link: audit_3	audit_3
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan has a component that is not a directory: a.rs/x	a.rs/x
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan is not an existing directory: a.rs	a.rs
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan is not an existing directory: src/lib.rs	src/lib.rs
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan is not an existing directory: missing	missing
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan is not a regular file or a directory: fifo	fifo
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan holds a control character: src?x	src@NL@x
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan holds a control character: ?[31msrc	@ESC@[31msrc
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan holds a control character: src?	src@TAB@
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan is longer than 1024 bytes	@LONG:1025@
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan must be relative to the working directory: @SHOWN(@WT@/../outside)@	@WT@/../outside
2	audit-scan: refused: the directory to scan passes through a symbolic link: src/linked.rs/x	src/linked.rs/x
# --out
2	audit-scan: refused: --out must be relative to the working directory: @SHOWN(@WT@/audit_1/prescan.json)@	src	--out	@WT@/audit_1/prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out must be relative to the working directory: @SHOWN(@OUT@/prescan.json)@	src	--out	@OUT@/prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out has an empty, . or .. component: ../outside/prescan.json	src	--out	../outside/prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out has an empty, . or .. component: audit_1/../audit_1/prescan.json	src	--out	audit_1/../audit_1/prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out has an empty, . or .. component: audit_1//prescan.json	src	--out	audit_1//prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out may not start with - or ~: ~/prescan.json	src	--out	~/prescan.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out holds a control character: audit_1/prescan?.json	src	--out	audit_1/prescan@NL@.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out must be audit_<n>/prescan.json or audit_<n>/prescan-<slug>.json, or the same in incident_<n>/, with a slug of 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -: prescan.json	src	--out	prescan.json

2	audit-scan: refused: --out must be audit_<n>/prescan.json or audit_<n>/prescan-<slug>.json, or the same in incident_<n>/, with a slug of 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -: audit_1/report.json	src	--out	audit_1/report.json
2	audit-scan: refused: --out must be audit_<n>/prescan.json or audit_<n>/prescan-<slug>.json, or the same in incident_<n>/, with a slug of 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -: audit_1/.gitignore	src	--out	audit_1/.gitignore
2	audit-scan: refused: --out must be audit_<n>/prescan.json or audit_<n>/prescan-<slug>.json, or the same in incident_<n>/, with a slug of 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -: audit_1/prescan.JSON	src	--out	audit_1/prescan.JSON
